text:
Fixed chirp#51 Bug 2. PR: https://github.com/pablof7z/chirp/pull/55 (branch chirp-ios-signer-banner, worktree /Users/pablofernandez/Work/chirp/.wt-signer-banner).

Root cause: AccountsView.swift gated the "Signer relay" health section only on `model.signerState != nil`. That's a kernel-owned GLOBAL slot (`nmp_core::actor::commands::identity::runtime::IdentityRuntime::signer_state`, written from crates/nmp-core/src/actor/commands/identity/signer_state.rs) that is never scoped or cleared per active account. A background NIP-46 bunker reconnect/handshake for a superseded or unrelated account (e.g. restored from a persisted session on cold start) can write into that slot and render against whatever account happens to be active — including a plain local-key account with no remote signer at all.

Fix (apps/ios/Chirp/Features/AccountsView.swift): additionally gate the section on the active account's own `signerIsRemote` field (`AccountSummary.signer_is_remote`), which Rust already exposes precisely for this purpose per its own doc comment. Now the section only renders when the active account actually has a remote signer.

Validated on iPhone 16 Simulator with NMP_TEST_NSEC (local-key-only sign-in):
- Before: reproduced the bug class live — Settings > Accounts showed "Signer relay: Connected" for the "Local key" account (docs/validation/ios-signer/01-before-local-key-false-banner.jpg). Note: this run's stale value was "Connected" rather than the originally-reported "Connection failed", but it's the identical defect (a signer-health section appearing at all for a local-key account).
- After: same session shows no signer-relay section (docs/validation/ios-signer/02-after-local-key-no-banner.jpg).
- Real-error path: verified by reading the diff rather than a live bunker-failure repro — the fix only adds one extra `&&` condition to the existing gate; SignerStateRow and every flag it reads (isReady/isAwaitingApproval/isReconnecting/isUnavailable/isFailed) are untouched, so a genuine remote-signer account still renders exactly as before.

Filed a genuine framework gap: pablof7z/nostr-multi-platform#2976 — signer_state has no per-account identity/keying at all, so even after this fix, two remote-signer accounts could still cross-contaminate each other's health (out of scope for a Chirp-side patch; documented root cause + repro + suggested fix in the issue).
